rationale: b (T9) spine: gate, tissue and imaging probes with partial-tagged distractors (ovary correctly partial). Added a second TR4 probe in contrast form (old-key question, idea from c/a) that only learners who missed the first TR4 probe and read the reveal are routed to, so correct learners do not get a longer segment; the trap option is 'keys never change', ovary is partial. lesson: When the winner probes a trap only once, add a different-form retest on the miss path only, so remediation gets a re-test without lengthening the strong learner's route.
